data.name: Nasr
data.gender_notes: Nasr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nasara' meaning 'to help, support, or assist'. In Islamic history, Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) used the term 'nasr' to describe the divine help and support that came to Muslims during the Battle of Badr. The name Nasr carries the meaning “Victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasr usually hope their child will grow to embody victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine support and victory.
data.etymology: Nasr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasr total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: In terms of spiritual significance, the name Nasr serves as a constant reminder that no matter how difficult the situation may be, Allah (SWT) is always there to provide help and support. It encourages believers to have faith and trust in Allah's divine plan and to seek His help in times of need. Additionally, the concept of 'Nasr' can also be seen as a reflection of the selfless support and encouragement that Muslims should give to each other within their community, embodying the spirit of unity and solidarity.
